newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - GIO says too early to predict result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - GIO says too early to predict result.

text.p: GIO Australia Holdings Ltd group managing director Bill Jocelyn said on Monday it was too early to predict the results for the full year to June 30, 1997 due to the fluctuations in the investment market.

"On the business side ... I would be more than disappointed if we don't more than match last year's business results, but overall for the group it depends on the returns from the investment side," Jocelyn said after the annual meeting.
GIO reported an operating profit before tax of A$102.5 million from its core insurance business activities and its investments had a profit of A$99.6 million.
